messages:
maria: quick design review request — playground streaming UX. thinking about: 1) where to put stop vs regenerate (inline button vs top-right message control), 2) token counter placement (message-level vs global rail), 3) show a small toast with undo when user stops a stream, 4) a11y: what should screen readers announce while streaming and on manual stop? alex: +1. my take: keep 'regenerate' in the message footer, move 'stop' to a consistent top-right control so it doesn't shift layout while streaming. avoids reflow. jon: agree re: reflow. concern: top-right control might be hard to hit on narrow screens. proposal: show compact stop icon top-right, and keep a secondary inline action for mobile. mockup attached (WIP). :art: sam: engineering notes — if stop is top-right we should expose a keyboard shortcut (Cmd+.) and a programmatic API for the console to call stopStreaming(messageId). also we can debounce the token counter updates to reduce layout jitter. priya: a11y notes: streaming partial updates should be announced via a live region with aria-live="polite" so screen readers don't get spammed. on manual stop we should explicitly set focus to the message container and announce "Streaming stopped; final partial content available." Also toast must be accessible (role="status"). Example: ```html
Streaming…
``` jon: copy nits: change "Stop" -> "Stop stream" (clearer), toast copy: "Stream stopped — undo" rather than just "Stopped". token counter tooltip: show two lines: "Visible tokens: 134" and "Estimated billable tokens: 210" to avoid confusion. alex: feasibility check: showing estimated billable tokens requires integration with billing tokenizer (we already have offline tokenizer in the service). cheap to add tooltip computation. debounce to 200ms for counter updates. maria: UX trade: if we show toast with undo, what's undo do? continue streaming from last cached token or restart full generation? sam: implementation thoughts: undo should resume the stream by rehydrating KV cache when possible and continuing from last token; if not possible just re-run with same params (quick fallback). we'll surface rollback mode in analytics. priya: accessibility follow-up: if undo resumes, announce "Resuming stream" in the live region and ensure screen readers don't replay entire transcript. maybe mark resumed content with aria-atomic="false" so only new parts read. jon: layout suggestion: token counter as a small pill at top-left of the message (compact) on desktop, and a global sticky token rail at the bottom on mobile. this keeps the counter near the content but not interfering with controls. maria: quick microcopy QA: token pill should read "134 tokens" (not "toks"), tooltip title "Token breakdown". also make the stop button label visible in screen-reader-only text. alex: dev note: will send a tiny PR for keyboard shortcut + top-right stop icon + debounced counter. need designs for compact mobile fallback. jon: I'll iterate mocks with two variants (A: top-right stop, token pill top-left; B: inline stop + global token rail on mobile). will post screenshots. priya: small a11y regression test checklist I can run: 1) screen reader reads updates politely 2) focus management on stop/undo 3) toast announced 4) token tooltip accessible via keyboard. I'll put it in a checklist. maria: sounds good — schedule a short review tomorrow 10:30am PT after the PR + mockups land. thanks everyone :thumbsup: a11y-bot: automated reminder: aria-live regions detected in proposed markup. please ensure role="status" and aria-atomic set appropriately before merge.
